page_title: JUV 1-1 VER | Juventus v Verona 03/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' The resulting free kick from Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
90+5' A yellow card for a tackle by Abdou Harroui (Verona). Giovanni Ayroldi doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90+4' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Lorenzo Montipo makes a comfortable save.

90+3' What a poor attempt! Kieron Bowie (Verona) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes miles wide to the right.
90+3' Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) takes a shot from inside the box and hits the right post!
90+2' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
90+2' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' The resulting set piece from Juventus is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
86' Jeremie Boga (Juventus) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
85' Michele Di Gregorio blocks Kieron Bowie (Verona)'s effort from the edge of the box.
82' Jeremie Boga (Juventus) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
80' Here comes a substitution. Abdou Harroui (Verona) is brought on as a substitute for Antoine Bernede.
80' Substitution. Lloyd Kelly walks off the pitch and Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) comes on as a substitute.
80' Luciano Spalletti has decided to make a change. Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) replaces Francisco Conceicao.
78' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post.
75' The corner is swung in but Juventus can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
75' Andrea Cambiaso will be replaced by Jeremie Boga (Juventus).
74' A pass into the penalty area from Weston McKennie (Juventus) is intercepted by the defence. The linesman points to the corner flag, Juventus are going to take it.
71' Paolo Sammarco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tobias Slotsager (Verona) replacing Domagoj Bradaric.
71' The substitution is prepared. Sandi Lovric (Verona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Tomas Suslov.
69' Substitution. Jonathan David makes way for Fabio Miretti (Juventus).
68' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Juventus.
68' Juventus take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The ball goes out of play and Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.

67' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Lorenzo Montipo shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.

67' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) was in a good shooting position inside the six-yard box and produced a first-time shot towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper made an astonishing save to thwart him.
66' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Verona).

66' Tomas Suslov (Verona) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Michele Di Gregorio!
64' Juventus fail to score from a corner as Lorenzo Montipo (Verona) leaps to collect the ball.

64' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Juventus.
63' Giovanni Ayroldi shows a yellow card to Antoine Bernede (Verona), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
62' 1 - 1 Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) proves that he is an excellent free-kick taker after finding the back of the net with a clever shot that goes straight into the bottom left corner!
61' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle after Antoine Bernede (Verona) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Juventus.
59' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
56' Rafik Belghali (Verona) cracks a volley from just outside the box, but his miskick goes skyward.
53' Lorenzo Montipo (Verona) is able to continue to play.
51' Lorenzo Montipo (Verona) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
51' Weston McKennie (Juventus) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.

49' Ambitious effort from Jonathan David (Juventus). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Khephren Thuram leaves the pitch and Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) comes on.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) poorly executes the free kick and the ball only hits the wall.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
39' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) got the ball on the edge of the box and fired in a first-time shot on goal, but his effort floated well over the bar. High, wide and not at all handsome.
39' Juventus take a short corner kick.

39' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Juventus will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
39' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
39' Juventus take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
38' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player. Now Juventus have a corner.
37' Verona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

36' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Kieron Bowie (Verona) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Verona have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

34' 0 - 1 What a goal! Domagoj Bradaric plays it to Kieron Bowie (Verona), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Michele Di Gregorio into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
33' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) is penalised.
31' Giovanni Ayroldi shows the yellow card to Martin Frese (Verona) for a heavy challenge.
28' How did he miss! The cross loops over the keeper leaving Bremer (Juventus) with an empty net, but somehow he heads the ball well wide of the right post from close range.
28' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
28' Weston McKennie (Juventus) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball is out of play. Juventus will have a chance to score from a corner.
27' Juventus take a short corner kick.

27' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Juventus can continue in their attacking effort.
27' Juventus work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
26' Bremer (Juventus) connects with a cross near the penalty spot and produces a header which hits the crossbar!
26' Juventus can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

24' Jonathan David (Juventus) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
22' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
21' The ball is out of play. Juventus win a corner kick.
21' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
19' Tomas Suslov (Verona) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
17' A quickly taken corner by Juventus.
17' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Juventus.
16' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Francisco Conceicao (Juventus), whose good effort would probably have ended inside the bottom right corner of the net.

13' What an opportunity! Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the right post!
12' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) plays a through ball but overhits it.
11' Juventus seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
7' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Lorenzo Montipo makes a comfortable save.
6' Juventus quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
6' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Francisco Conceicao (Juventus). Juventus force a corner. They send men into the box.
6' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
5' Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Giovanni Ayroldi didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
3' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Juventus will take the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Giovanni Ayroldi is introduced as the referee for today's match.
